A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VCWorld study and contain readable methods, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–D. Relocated and renumbered material can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original GeneTAK prediction experiments in Tables 1–3, alongside ablation, retrieval-sensitivity and cost/latency results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original GeneTAK prediction experiments, component ablations, retrieval-sensitivity results and cost/latency measurements.

M1.justification: Knowledge-graph construction, LLM-generated descriptions, semantic/structural retrieval, analogue and contrast cases, and Chain-of-Thought inference remain unchanged. The completed example output does not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same GeneTAK coverage: five cell lines, 348 drug perturbations, and DE/DIR tasks. The Larotrectinib–MKI67 and Tofacitinib–FTH1 examples already appear in v1; relocation and completion do not expand coverage.

E2.justification: Random, GAT, CPA, scVI and STATE retain their membership in corresponding comparisons, alongside the same VCWorld variants. Removing the stray 'linear model' wording and shortening Qwen labels do not remove or replace an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Reported splits, preprocessing thresholds, zero-shot retrieval restrictions, metrics, model configurations and inference settings are unchanged. The removal of detailed sample-count reporting does not establish an actual change in evaluation settings.

E4.justification: v2 removes the detailed response-count breakdown for backbone/BioContext/CoT ablations in v1 Table 8, while retaining aggregate accuracies and Figure 3. It also completes the existing Tofacitinib–FTH1 worked example. Retrieval-depth and retrieval-set-size analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains identical ± reporting, without changes to run-count, seed or uncertainty-estimation disclosures. The Wilcoxon and multiple-testing procedures also remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Retained benchmark and sensitivity tables have identical numerical values. However, v1 Table 8's total/answered/correct counts disappear, including C32's 5,691 total, 4,874 answered and 3,412 correct for full VCWorld. Appendix D adds the explicit positive DE prediction for the existing Tofacitinib–FTH1 example.

T1.justification: The task definitions, method equations, normalization formula and metric definitions are mathematically unchanged. Removing the normalization equation's number and adjusting mathematical typography are presentation edits.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central contributions: an interpretable, data-efficient biological world model, the GeneTAK benchmark, and claimed state-of-the-art DE/DIR performance.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 replaces the broad attribution of baseline weaknesses to fixed statistical assumptions with more task-specific interpretations. It newly emphasizes graph-derived directional signals for GAT and likely skewed CPA/STATE predictions in this experimental setup. The stated future directions and applicability boundaries remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Deleting v1 Table 8 removes per-cell evaluation denominators and answered/correct counts. Appendix A.1 also changes 'Seurat v3 method' to 'Seurat v3 Python package', without establishing a changed preprocessing procedure. Inference parameters, cost information, prompt templates and code-access statements are retained.

R1.justification: The reference list and substantive related-work positioning are unchanged. Citations supporting the Larotrectinib case move with that discussion into Appendix C.

P1.justification: v2 locally rewrites Section 4.3 into separate DE/DIR discussions, trims repetitive ablation prose, consolidates the Larotrectinib case in Appendix C and reorganizes appendix headings. It also updates publication/author text and adds acknowledgments; most prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 4 moves from the main text to Appendix C, Figure 3 is repositioned, and v1 Table 8 is removed. Later tables are renumbered, and Appendix D gains a response-continuation panel. Existing figure content and retained table structures are largely preserved.

improvement.justification: The clearer DE/DIR discussion and completed Appendix D example are useful, but deleting v1 Table 8 removes unique totals and answered/correct counts without replacement. This weakens readers' ability to audit abstention and the denominators behind reported accuracy. With the main experimental evidence otherwise unchanged, this limited loss of transparency outweighs the editorial gains.
